members.name: src
members.doc: Final image URL. Cross-origin images work (pixels are never read back). Omit to cycle through sample photos.

members.name: alt
members.doc: Alt text for the final image, used as the canvas label once done. Default: "Generated image".

members.name: status
members.doc: Controlled state. Omit for auto mode, which runs queued, sampling over `duration`, decoding over `decodeDuration`, then done. Going straight from generating to done still plays the decode. Every change transitions smoothly.

members.name: progress
members.doc: Controlled progress from 0 to 1 while generating, usually step / total. The canvas moves one denoising step at a time, like the real sampler. Omit to step at a constant rate over `duration`.

members.name: duration
members.doc: Milliseconds the sampling steps take when `progress` is not controlled. Default: 4600.

members.name: decodeDuration
members.doc: Milliseconds the tiled decode takes after the last step. Default: 560.

members.name: steps
members.doc: Sampling steps. Each is one visible denoising step, and the pill shows it as 18 / 30. Default: 30.

members.name: aspectRatio
members.doc: Width over height, as a number (1.5) or a CSS ratio ("4 / 5"). The image is cover-cropped to it. Default: 1.

members.name: size
members.doc: Overlay scale and corner radius. "sm" (grids, thumbnails) shows only the ring and 18 / 30; "md" and "lg" add the Denoising label. Default: "md".

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color for the progress ring. Defaults to the accent.

members.name: showProgress
members.doc: Shows the translucent progress pill. It fades out shortly after the image resolves. Default: true.

members.name: sheen
members.doc: Plays one soft light sheen across the image when it resolves. Skipped with reduced motion. Default: true.

members.name: queueLabel
members.doc: Chip label while queued, such as "Queued, 2 ahead". Default: "Queued".

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: Message in the error state. Default: "Generation failed".

members.name: onRetry
members.doc: Shows a Retry button in the error state.

members.name: onStatusChange
members.doc: Called when the displayed status changes, including auto mode transitions.

members.name: onComplete
members.doc: Called once per run when the final image is fully resolved and crisp.

members.name: autoPlay
members.doc: Auto mode only: starts generating on mount. Default: true.

members.name: loop
members.doc: Auto mode only: after `holdDuration` the image blurs back out and generates again. Default: true.

members.name: startDelay
members.doc: Auto mode only: extra queue time in milliseconds before a run, for staggered grids. Default: 0.

members.name: queueDuration
members.doc: Auto mode only: milliseconds in the queue before each run. Default: 900.

members.name: holdDuration
members.doc: Auto mode only: milliseconds the finished image holds before a loop restarts. Default: 2600.

members.name: runKey
members.doc: Auto mode only: change it to blur back out and run again (a Generate again button).

members.name: seed
members.doc: Seeds the latent noise, so tiles in a batch differ and a replay of the same seed shows the same noise. Default: 1.
